title: Nell and the Bright Petal
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 longer-word practice, 57-sound stage (dr, fl, fr just added) — blending words like 'drops' and 'bright'. A true fact: bees use careful, repeated searching and familiar landmarks to relocate something in a large area.

pages.illustration: Nell the bee flying high up above a patch of tall wildflowers.
Nell the bee holding a small bright pink petal.
The small bright pink petal falling from Nell’s grip toward the ground below.
Nell the bee looking down, unable to spot the petal among the plants.
Nell the bee flying back down toward the flowers to search.

pages.text: Nell checks a flower. No petal.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee checking closely around one yellow flower, no petal there.

pages.text: Nell checks a bud. No petal.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee checking closely around a closed flower bud, no petal there.
Nell the bee flying slowly along, checking each plant one by one.

pages.text: Nell spots the bright petal on a twig!
pages.illustration: Nell the bee spotting the bright pink petal resting on a thin green twig.
